method: 3 isolated histories x 4 current-year URLs x 2 fresh sessions, SQLite, original routes/templates, no network.
limitations: Five January events per season, five members, two expense bookings per fiscal year; no receipts/claims/imports.
Adding seasons also adds past events; global cleanup cost remains part of request totals.
All fiscal years open for fixture simplicity; no close/revision scenario.
SQL/ORM counts and HTML bytes are not latency, PostgreSQL scan counts or production load.
